title: Resolving sources of uncertainty in AI weather forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2511.14218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Weather forecast uncertainty arises from imperfect analyses and forecast models, but ensemble spread alone does not reveal how distinct sources relate to downstream targets. We introduce Pangu-Bayes, a probabilistic forecasting hierarchy that treats atmospheric-state and learned-model uncertainty as distinct stochastic variables, crossing flow-dependent perturbations of the evolving state with Bayesian parameter samples. This construction yields model-defined source-resolved variance components and matched pathway evaluation. Across 90 held-out 2023 tropical cyclones, Pangu-Bayes reduces track, pressure and wind errors by 54.2%, 17.2% and 24.9%, respectively, while improving rapid-intensification detection. translated_title: 解析AI天气预报中不确定性的来源
translated_abstract: 天气预报的不确定性来源于不完美的分析场和预报模式，但仅靠集合离散度无法揭示不同来源与下游预报目标之间的关系。我们提出了Pangu-Bayes，这是一个概率预报层级框架，将大气状态不确定性与学习模型不确定性视为不同的随机变量，将随流演变的状态扰动与贝叶斯参数样本进行交叉组合。这一构造产生了由模式定义的、可区分来源的方差分量以及匹配的路径评估方法。在90个2023年留出的热带气旋上，Pangu-Bayes将路径、气压和风速误差分别降低了54.2%、17.2%和24.9%，同时提高了对快速增强过程的检测能力。在88个支持路径比较的气旋中，大气状态变率与改进的路径预报更为一致地相关，而学习模型变率则更多地与改进的强度预报相关。
tldr: 提出Pangu-Bayes概率预报框架，将大气状态不确定性与学习模型不确定性作为独立随机变量分开建模，实现了误差来源的可解析归因，并在热带气旋预报中显著降低路径、气压和风速误差。
en_tdlr: Introduces Pangu-Bayes, a probabilistic forecasting hierarchy that treats atmospheric-state and learned-model uncertainty as distinct stochastic variables, enabling source-resolved uncertainty attribution and substantially reducing tropical cyclone track, pressure, and wind forecast errors.
